PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 5, 2024
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Gina Maguire, President  Naiomi Rainey, Commissioner
Kevin Scott, Vice President  Robert Shannon, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 CALL TO ORDER

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-55737  Recommendation to approve November 21, 2024 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  24-55738  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute an agreement,
  including any necessary amendments, with Duncan, Weinberg, Genzer &
  Pembroke, P.C. for legal services in an annual amount not to exceed $100,000 for
  a period of three years, and to authorize the General Manager to exercise the
  option to renew for three additional one-year periods.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  24-55739  Recommendation to adopt Specifications UD-25-214 and authorize the General
  Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter into an agreement, including
  any necessary subsequent amendments, with All American Asphalt to provide
  street repair services in an amount not to exceed $5,500,000 for a period of one
  year, and to authorize the General Manager to exercise the option to renew for two
  additional one-year periods, with each renewal year subject to a not-to-exceed
  amount of $660,000, for a total contract amount not to exceed $6,820,000.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  24-55740  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal (RFP) EO-3687 and award an
  agreement with Stantec Consulting Services Inc., a New York corporation, to
  provide engineering design services for the Groundwater Treatment Plant Booster
  Pump Station Rehabilitation Project (EO-3687), in an amount not to exceed
  $1,125,846; and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to enter into the agreement, including any necessary subsequent
  amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 4
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 5, 2024
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

5.  24-55741  Recommendation to adopt Specifications WD-01-24 for the J. Will Johnson
  Reservoir Chemical Dosing Project (EO-3583) and authorize the General Manager
  to execute all documents necessary to enter into a construction contract, including
  any necessary subsequent amendments, with Green Building Corporation, in an
  amount not to exceed $3,966,620.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-55742  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal (RFP) EO-3583 and award an
  agreement with Lee & Ro, Inc., to provide construction management and inspection
  services for the J. Will Johnson Reservoir Chemical Dosing Project (EO-3583), in
  an amount not to exceed $692,521; and authorize the General Manager to execute
  all documents necessary to enter into the agreement, including any necessary
  subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  24-55743  Recommendation to adopt Specifications WD-11-23 for the Large Potable Water
  Valve Replacement Project Orange Avenue & Carson Street / San Antonio Drive,
  Stearns Street & Lakewood Boulevard (EO-3637) and authorize the General
  Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter into the agreement, including
  any necessary subsequent amendments with Stephen Doreck Equipment Rentals,
  Inc., in an amount not to exceed $1,864,175.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  24-55744  Recommendaton to authorize the General Manager to issue Task Order No. 02-
  2024 under On-Call Construction Management Services (CMS) Contract No. UT-
  3888 to JIG Consultants to provide Construction Management and Inspection
  Services for the Large Potable Water Valve Replacement Project - Orange Avenue
  & Carson Street / San Antonio Drive, Stearns Street & Lakewood Boulevard (EO-
  3637), in the amount not to exceed $297,670.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  24-55745  Receive and file report on Metropolitan Water District Conjunctive Use Program
  and Reverse Cyclic Program.

  Suggested Action:  Receive and file.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 5, 2024
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Dynna Long, Executive Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, or if you need the agenda provided in an alternate format, please call the Board
of Public Utilities Commissioners Executive Assistant at (562) 570-2435 or (562) 570-6626
(telecommunications for the deaf) by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.

  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD

Si desea interpretación oral en otro idioma para personas que no hablan inglés o si desea una
